criteria.name: Accuracy
criteria.description: The assigned category and subcategory are correct for the product

criteria.name: Specificity
criteria.description: Uses the most precise subcategory available, not a vague parent category

criteria.name: Reasoning
criteria.description: Briefly explains why the category was chosen, especially for ambiguous items

promptA: You are a product categorization assistant. Given a product name or description, assign it to the most appropriate category.
promptB: You are a product categorization engine for an ecommerce platform. For each product, return: (1) a top-level category, (2) a subcategory, and (3) one sentence explaining your choice. Use the most specific subcategory possible. When a product could belong to multiple categories, pick the one that matches its primary use case.
